goal: Detection of attack groups completely excluded from model training, rather than only unseen sessions.
calibration: Fresh verify_v2 session normal rows only; target FPR0.005
test: Fresh verify_v2_retest session normals plus held-out attack group
model: Fixed300tree balanced RF seed42,26stablefeatures; no heldout tuning
limitations: Controlled local/dummy behavior groups; not unknown real compromise or zero-day efficacy
Specified after known-type V2 metric, before any group-heldout scores; feature design informed by existing development research
One test session; correlated buckets and small groups

training_regimes.two_sessions: First two canonical training session IDs, V1-like amount, with held-out group excluded
training_regimes.four_sessions: All four canonical training session IDs, V2-like amount, with held-out group excluded

regime_comparison: Same model parameters,26 features, fresh normal calibration and test for both regimes; measure extra development data effect without treating a model trained on target attacks as unseen baseline.
